errata.quote: Рифампицин и остальные рифамицины являются сильными ингибиторами изофермента CYP3A4
errata.evidence: The English original (10665-331525, p. 77) reads 'Being potent CYP3A4 inducers, rifampicin and other rifamycins, decrease exposure to quinine'. The table on this same page says rifamycins 'ускоряют метаболизм и снижают уровень в крови' (speed up metabolism and lower blood levels), which is what an inducer does.

narrative.text: The Russian edition calls rifamycins strong CYP3A4 inhibitors; the English original and this page's own table say they are inducers, which is why they lower quinine and mefloquine levels.

errata.quote: e.	Включая гепатит (острый или хронический), симптомы периферической нейропатии
errata.reading: e. Схема лечения выбирается с учетом возраста, штамма (лекарственно-чувствительный или иной), риска токсичности, доступности и предпочтений.
errata.evidence: Footnote e of the algorithm repeats footnote d word for word. In the English original (10665-331525, p. 44) footnote e reads 'Regimen chosen based on considerations of age, strain (drug susceptible or otherwise), risk of toxicity, availability and preferences.' Footnote e is attached to 'Назначить профилактическое лечение' (give preventive treatment).

narrative.text: In the Russian algorithm, footnote e repeats footnote d (contraindications). In the English original, footnote e says how to choose the regimen.
